cards.title: The framework Orbi
cards.text: Who answers beside the framework's pages: an AI that speaks for the framework, on two packs, and sells nothing.

cards.title: The docs pack
cards.text: What it answers from: the framework as its docs tell it, with the doc's path.

cards.title: The site pack
cards.text: Finds a place on the site, shows it, and ends each answer with choices.
